### REF-007

[Canonical record](../references/REF-007.md)

- **Title:** Eye-mask and earplugs compared with sleep advice leaflet to improve night sleep duration in pregnancy: a randomized controlled trial
- **Authors:** Gan F, Sooriappragasarao M, Sulaiman S, Razali N, Hong JGS, Tan PC
- **Year:** 2023
- **Source:** Sleep
- **Source type:** primary research
- **Design:** randomized controlled trial, n=210, sleep-deprived women in late pregnancy
- **DOI:** 10.1093/sleep/zsad196
- **URLs:**
  - https://academic.oup.com/sleep/article/46/12/zsad196/7227835
- **Supports:**
  - Eye-mask plus earplugs increased actigraphy-measured night sleep duration and improved reported sleep quality relative to a sleep-advice leaflet in this specific population.

### REF-012

[Canonical record](../references/REF-012.md)

- **Title:** Buying time promotes happiness
- **Authors:** Whillans AV, Dunn EW, Smeets P, Bekkers R, Norton MI
- **Year:** 2017
- **Source:** Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
- **Source type:** primary research
- **Design:** cross-national observational studies plus randomized crossover experiment
- **DOI:** 10.1073/pnas.1706541114
- **PMID:** 28739889
- **URLs:**
  - https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5559044/
- **Supports:**
  - In the randomized crossover experiment, spending money on a time-saving purchase reduced reported time pressure and negative affect relative to spending the same amount on a material purchase.

### REF-052

[Canonical record](../references/REF-052.md)

- **Title:** Efficacy of pink noise and earplugs for mitigating the effects of intermittent environmental noise exposure on sleep
- **Authors:** Basner M, et al.
- **Year:** 2026
- **Source:** Sleep
- **Source type:** primary research
- **Design:** controlled sleep-laboratory experiment, n=25
- **DOI:** 10.1093/sleep/zsag001
- **PMID:** 41627391
- **URLs:**
  - https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41627391/
- **Supports:**
  - Intermittent environmental noise disturbed sleep; earplugs mitigated some effects, while pink noise was not uniformly beneficial and reduced REM sleep in this study.
